slots.purpose: Hero: set a warm, luxurious, real-wedding tone for a Serbian wedding without leaning on any single contested custom.
slots.shot_brief: Real Serbian or Serbian-Australian wedding, licensed from the photographer with couple consent: the couple leaving a Serbian Orthodox church or joined by guests in an outdoor kolo, golden late-afternoon light, late spring or early autumn, joyful and candid, landscape 16:9 with room for a title. No national flags, political symbols or firearms; no identifiable children without consent. Inspiration only from ranking pages, never their images.

slots.alt: Bride and groom leave a Serbian Orthodox church as guests celebrate in warm afternoon light
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] <Church>, <town>. Photo: <credit>

slots.anchor_h3: The kum and kuma (custom 2; prosidba and engagement image may sit at custom 1 instead)
slots.purpose: Show the kum and kuma as the thread through the day, the article's central idea.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed real-wedding photo: the kum and kuma standing beside the couple (at the church or signing as witnesses), natural light, adults only, consent from all identifiable people. Alternative: the prosidba or engagement, families together at a home table, candid. No staged stock that misrepresents roles.
slots.alt: Kum and kuma stand beside the bride and groom as wedding witnesses
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] <Place>, <town>. Photo: <credit>

slots.anchor_h3: The barjak (wedding flag) leading the svatovi
slots.purpose: Show the wedding barjak carried by the barjaktar at the head of the wedding party.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed real-wedding photo only: the barjaktar holding the decorated wedding barjak (flag with apple, towel or flowers as the family dresses it) as the svatovi set out, daylight, street or village lane. The wedding barjak is the only flag permitted in frame: no national, state, religious-political or other flags, no political symbols, no firearms anywhere in shot. Never AI.
slots.alt: Wedding party sets out behind a decorated wedding flag carried by the flag bearer
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] <Place>, <town>. Photo: <credit>

slots.anchor_h3: The Serbian Orthodox service: crowning (rings, common cup, walk around the table)
slots.purpose: Illustrate the crowning, the visual heart of the Orthodox rite sourced from the Church.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed real-wedding photo inside a Serbian Orthodox church (Serbia or an Australian parish) showing the wedding crowns held over or worn by the couple, candlelight and icons, photographed with the parish's permission. Couple and priest consent required. Never AI, never stock that depicts another rite.
slots.alt: Wedding crowns held above a bride and groom during a Serbian Orthodox service
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] <Church>, <town>. Photo: <credit>

slots.anchor_h3: The welcome at the groom's home (bread; a child on the bride's lap, as often told)
slots.purpose: Show the welcome at the groom's home, framed in the text as often told.
slots.shot_brief: Preferred: licensed real-wedding photo of the bride welcomed at the groom's family door with bread, adults only or with documented parental consent for any child. Fallback allowed by the brief: a neutral AI still life of a round loaf of bread (and salt) on a linen cloth on a wooden table, no people, no costume, no place, no religious or national symbols, labelled 'Illustrative image' and used only after Nic approves. Not generated in this run.
slots.alt: Round loaf of bread on a linen cloth ready to welcome the bride
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] If AI fallback: Illustrative image, pending approval.

slots.purpose: Show the kolo as guests join hands in the circle dance, linked to the UNESCO-listed element.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed real-wedding photo of guests dancing the kolo in a joined-hands circle at a reception, motion and joy, evening light or festoon lights, couple and identifiable guests consented. No flags or political symbols in frame; folk dress only if it is a real photo of real guests. Never AI.
slots.alt: Wedding guests join hands and dance the kolo in a circle at an evening reception
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] <Place>, <town>. Photo: <credit>

slots.anchor_h3: Marrying in Serbia (legal and travel section)
slots.purpose: Give the destination section a sense of place in northern Serbia, well away from the southern border areas Smartraveller flags.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed photo (stock with written licence, the Wedded Wonderland library, or a tourism-board image with written permission) of Belgrade at golden hour (Kalemegdan over the confluence of the Sava and Danube) or Novi Sad (Petrovaradin Fortress above the Danube). Landscape, no people or only distant non-identifiable people, no flags, no political monuments or symbols. Nothing from southern Serbia near the Kosovo border, Presevo or Bujanovac. Never AI.
slots.alt: Belgrade's Kalemegdan fortress above the meeting of the Sava and Danube at sunset
slots.caption: [[IMAGE NEEDED]] Kalemegdan, Belgrade. Photo: <credit>
